mapper.select: SELECT content FROM ai_prompt_config WHERE prompt_key = #{promptKey} AND status = 1 AND is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ai_prompt_config ORDER BY category, prompt_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_prompt_config (prompt_key, prompt_name, content, category, description, status, version, is_active) VALUES (#{promptKey}, #{promptName}, #{content}, #{category}, #{description}, #{status}, #{version}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(version) FROM ai_prompt_config WHERE prompt_key = #{promptKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_prompt_config SET is_active = 0 WHERE prompt_key = #{promptKey}
UPDATE ai_prompt_config SET is_active = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
